user.title: Add an appliance
user.description: GE Home (SmartHQ) appliances are set up automatically. Doors (garage, patio…) and other brands use the second option.

ge_home.title: GE appliance (SmartHQ)
ge_home.description: Pick the washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven or refrigerator. Its state, cycle, time-remaining and door entities are found automatically.

data_description.name: Shown as the Live Activity title. Blank = the device name.

data_description.remaining_entity: Hours, minutes or seconds — the unit is read from the sensor.
data_description.done_entity: Turns on when a cycle finishes. Optional, but makes 'Done' detection exact.
data_description.door_entity: Opening the door dismisses a finished Live Activity.
data_description.delay_entity: While a delayed start is waiting, the Live Activity counts down to the start.
data_description.timer_entity: A timer set on the oven gets its own countdown Live Activity and a "Timer done" alert.
data_description.probe_entity: Live Activity with the probe temperature. Set the target with the appliance's Probe Target number.
data_description.tumble_entity: Shows "tumbling to prevent wrinkles" after the cycle until the door opens.

data.dismiss_minutes: Dismiss the finished Live Activity after
data.open_delay_seconds: Start the Live Activity after the door is open for
data.escalate_after: Escalate after this many critical alerts
data.escalation_devices: Also alert these phones when escalated
data.alert_lights: Turn these lights red when escalated
data.preheat_alert: Alert when the oven is preheated
data.move_reminder_minutes: Remind to move laundry after (0 = off)
data.dryer_entity: Dryer state sensor (stops the reminder when the dryer starts)
data.delay_start: Live Activity while a delayed start is waiting
data.dryer_start_entity: Dryer start button (adds a "Start dryer" button)
data.snooze_minutes: Snooze button on critical alerts (0 = no button)
data.combine_laundry: One Live Activity for the washer and dryer
data.supply_low: Remind when this many (loads, pods, sheets) are left

data_description.finished_alert: Changing a Live Activity to Done doesn't always alert you; this does.
data_description.dismiss_minutes: It is also dismissed as soon as the door opens.
data_description.open_delay_seconds: Quick grabs don't start a Live Activity (iOS limits how many can be started).
data_description.critical_after_minutes: Critical alerts bypass Silent and Focus until the door is closed.
data_description.escalate_after: 0 = escalate with the first critical alert. Speakers and lights are only used once escalated.
data_description.cooktop_alert_minutes: Critical alert with an Acknowledge button; repeats until the cooktop is off or acknowledged. The cooktop is never turned off.
data_description.preheat_alert: A time-sensitive alert when the oven reaches its set temperature. The Live Activity shows the temperature climbing while it preheats.
data_description.move_reminder_minutes: After the washer finishes, remind everyone until the washer door is opened, the dryer starts or you tap Laundry moved.
data_description.leak_entities: Critical alert the moment any of these detects water, repeated until it's dry (or you tap Silence until dry). Sensors named after the appliance are found automatically.
data_description.tts_entity: Used for leak, cooktop and door announcements.
data_description.delay_start: Counts down to when the cycle starts ("Scheduled · starts at 3:45 PM"), then switches to the normal countdown.
data_description.dryer_start_entity: The alerts get "Start dryer" and "Laundry moved" buttons. Start dryer presses this button; the dryer's Remote Start must be on.
data_description.snooze_minutes: Pauses the critical alerts for this long while the door stays open. The Live Activity stays.
data_description.combine_laundry: Washing → move to the dryer → drying → done, all in one "Laundry" Live Activity. iOS limits how many Live Activities you can have at once.
data_description.supply_entities: After a cycle, one reminder listing what's low (detergent tank, pods, rinse aid, dryer sheets). Each is mentioned once until it's refilled. Percentages count as low at 25 % or less.
data_description.vent_entity: Critical alert while the dryer reports a blocked vent (a fire risk), repeated every 30 minutes.
data_description.filter_entity: A reminder when the filter needs replacing, and a critical alert if it reports a leak.

oven_cavity.title: Double oven
oven_cavity.description: This is a double oven. Choose which oven to set up, then add the integration again for the other one.

error.no_ge_entities: No state sensor was found on this device. Use "Any appliance" setup instead.
error.unknown_type: Couldn't tell what kind of appliance this is — choose the type.
